title: AMEND the Life-of-Project (LOP) budget for the Westside Purple (D) Line Extension Section 2 Project (Project) by $296,000,000 from $2,574,969,299 to…
text:
[Metro Board file 2026-0591, Project]
[FINANCE, BUDGET, AND AUDIT COMMITTEE MADE THE FOLLOWING RECOMMENDATION (4-0):]
AMEND the Life-of-Project (LOP) budget for the Westside Purple (D) Line Extension Section 2 Project (Project) by $296,000,000 from $2,574,969,299 to $2,870,969,299 using the fund sources as summarized in Attachment A and consistent with the provisions of the Board-adopted Measure R and Measure M Unified Cost Management Policy (Attachment B).
